detectors.fixed-limit-115C: naive warning light: >= 115 C for 2 consecutive samples; no reference, time or quality logic
detectors.v0.1-as-shipped: frozen v0.1 rule on raw rows; the run fails if v0.1 rejects any row
detectors.v0.1-cleaned: frozen v0.1 rule after oracle-free cleaning (drop unparseable rows, sort, de-duplicate)
detectors.v0.2-fixed-8C: ablation: v0.1's fixed 8 C threshold instead of 4 x robust scale

H1.claim: v0.2 raises fewer false alerts than v0.1 on normal operation

H2.claim: placebo-controlled: v0.2 detects abrupt anomalies and drift at least as well as v0.1 (excess recall = recall - placebo recall)
H2.evidence: abrupt: v0.2 recall 1.0 placebo 0.0 vs v0.1 recall 1.0 placebo 1.0; drift: v0.2 recall 1.0 placebo 0.0 (median bias at detection 3.917 C) vs v0.1 recall 1.0 placebo 1.0

H3.claim: without a load signal legitimate load increases cause false alerts; with it v0.2 avoids most

H4.claim: v0.2 reduces false reassurance ('normal' while the sensor is frozen)
H4.evidence: share of frozen-sensor rows reported normal: v0.2 0.0381 vs v0.1 0.9089

H5.evidence: normal rows on vehicles without reference: 0

H6.claim: (expected negative) severe cold lengthens warm-up beyond warmup_s and raises v0.2 false alerts
H6.evidence: v0.2 false alerts/1000 h: seasonal 45.806 [23.668, 80.013] vs normal 0.0 [0.0, 14.081]; by condition {'cold_season': 6, 'hot_season': 6}

H7.claim: (expected negative) a fault present during the whole reference period is missed by the relative barrier
H7.evidence: relative barrier only (v0.2-no-absolute): {'overheat_in_reference_full': '0/4', 'overheat_in_reference_partial': '3/4'}; with the absolute barrier (v0.2): {'overheat_in_reference_full': '0/4', 'overheat_in_reference_partial': '3/4'}

notice: Synthetic data generated by the same project that wrote the detector. These numbers verify behaviour against documented assumptions; they are not evidence of real-world accuracy and say nothing about failure prediction.

abrupt_anomaly.description: v0-v2 cooling failure (overheat, strongest at low speed); v3-v4 thermostat stuck open (runs cold); v5-v7 controls.

contaminated_reference.description: v0-v1 overheat starts in the last 30 % of the reference period; v2-v3 during the whole reference period.

data_integrity.description: All vehicles: duplicates, conflicting duplicates, late rows, mixed UTC offsets; v0-v2 overheat.

gradual_sensor_drift.description: v0-v4 coolant sensor bias drifts 0.3-1.0 C/day (alternating sign); v5-v7 controls.

load_change.description: False-positive condition: v0-v4 start towing (+20-35 % load, legitimately hotter); v5-v7 controls.

normal_operation.description: Negative control: multi-regime driving, cold starts, hills; no injected events.

seasonal_shift.description: False-positive condition: v0-v3 hot season (+15-20 C ambient); v4-v7 severe cold (-25-30 C, longer warm-up than the detector assumes).

stress_abrupt_noise_x2.description: Robustness: abrupt anomalies with twice the sensor noise.

stress_noise_x2.description: Robustness: normal operation with twice the sensor noise.

stress_sampling_60s.description: Robustness: abrupt anomalies sampled every 60 s instead of 30 s.

unreliable_sensor.description: All vehicles: 5 % missing readings, 0.4 % spikes/sentinels; v0-v2 sensor freezes.

unseen_vehicles_and_regimes.description: v0-v2 have no reference data (v0 overheats); v3-v5 reference lacks highway driving (v4 overheats).
